## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Bologna, Italy. It starts at 319 Strada Provinciale 4 Galliera Sud.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ferruccio Lamborghini lived life to the full, and a visit to the Ferruccio Lamborghini Museum will show you how he transformed his family's beginnings as an agricultural family to one of the most prestigious names in luxury cars.
>
> The 9,000-square-meter space chronicles Lamborghini's life story through archival family photos, a recreation of his first office at Lamborghini Trattori, and of course with a collection of Lamborghini cars, tractors, and even a world-champion speed boat.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.12. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 78 ratings and 43 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
